title: Quantizing Pythagorean triples
summary: We introduce a $q$-deformation of the Pythagoras equation $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$, which is a polynomial version of it different from the standard one. We construct a polynomial analogue, or ``$q$-analogue'', of every primitive Pythagorean triple. We also construct such analogue for a larger class of Pythagorean triples called standard. Our approach is based on the notion of $q$-deformed rational numbers and the modular group $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$.
